scope: CLI final-render lossless request compaction source only
conclusions: Initial and existing single JSON fallback adapter paths both compact the builder-owned request before adapter.generate. Only the new helper and its two call sites change. Public core types, evidence admission/authority, answer verification, model choice, retry count, and output/input budget values are unchanged by this commit.

Initial compaction requires the entire task/verdict/typed-artifact prefix and suffix to equal the request. Fallback streams one builder-owned JSON schema and requires the complete remaining template to match. Request fields other than task and JSON values within the task are preserved. Internal builder-owned request scope is assumed; this helper is not a general untrusted request/schema validator.

Independent probes preserve caller text even when it contains the entire actual pretty artifact, plus marker strings, quoted whitespace, escapes and Unicode. Wrong task/artifact/verdict, altered tail and malformed/missing fallback schema prefix fail closed. Each frozen arm rejects all ten targeted negative inputs.

Saved baseline request shrinks6956 to5846 bytes (fallback7274 to5675). Saved candidate failure request shrinks13365 to11186 bytes (fallback13683 to11015). Baseline nonempty claims2/receipts1 and candidate claims6/receipts4 are byte-identical before/after; artifact values, outside text, system/schema/seed/max_tokens/preferences remain unchanged.

These results establish source/request preservation and remove the saved size blocker at unchanged caps. They do not establish identical model responses, full successor cohort completion, quality/F1 improvement or runtime/live admission.
